name: 70808 · Baton Rouge, LA
findings: ZIP 70808 (Baton Rouge) has 213 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70808 (Baton Rouge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 15 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
